name: IV Tank
description: The Panzer-IV tank (full name in German: Panzerkampfwagen IV) is a medium tank produced by Nazi Germany in World War II. It is often called the Panzer IV tank in China. It was originally designed to support infantry and work in conjunction with the Panzer III tank, which specialized in anti-tank missions. When the overall performance of the Panzer III tank gradually failed to meet the needs of armored combat in the middle of World War II, the Panzer IV tank was transformed into a main assault tank for use by armored divisions because the technology used was relatively mature and there was room for improvement. During World War II, the Panzer IV produced modified tanks for various purposes, including assault guns, self-propelled anti-tank guns, ammunition carriers, bridge tanks, etc. Because of its reliable performance and diverse uses, it was nicknamed the Army Horse by German soldiers.
